access: sqlite uri mode=ro; PRAGMA query_only=ON; single read transaction

queries.counts: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM sources) sources,(SELECT count(*) FROM papers) papers,(SELECT count(*) FROM paper_versions) paperVersions,(SELECT count(*) FROM page_revisions) pageRevisions,(SELECT count(*) FROM paper_reviews) paperReviews,(SELECT count(*) FROM question_versions) questionVersions,(SELECT count(*) FROM content_issues) contentIssues
queries.jobSummary: SELECT job_type,status,count(*) count FROM jobs GROUP BY job_type,status
queries.pageSignatures: SELECT CASE WHEN signed_by IS NULL THEN "UNSIGNED" WHEN signed_by LIKE "machine:%" THEN "MACHINE" ELSE "HUMAN" END signatureType,count(*) count FROM page_revisions GROUP BY signatureType
queries.latestPageSignatures: WITH latest AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY source_id,role,page_number ORDER BY created_at DESC,rowid DESC) rn FROM page_revisions) SELECT CASE WHEN signed_by IS NULL THEN "UNSIGNED" WHEN signed_by LIKE "machine:%" THEN "MACHINE" ELSE "HUMAN" END signatureType,count(*) count FROM latest WHERE rn=1 GROUP BY signatureType
queries.explanationStatuses: SELECT status,count(*) count FROM explanation_revisions GROUP BY status
queries.deliveryStates: SELECT state,count(*) count FROM paper_delivery_state GROUP BY state
queries.publicationOutbox: SELECT status,count(*) count FROM publication_outbox GROUP BY status
queries.migrations: SELECT version,name FROM schema_migrations ORDER BY version

latestVersionSummary.note: ACTIVE means no explicit delivery-state row; this is a statistical default, not a full certificate revalidation. Latest selection uses MAX(version_number) per paper_id.
